units.note: Opening fragment (ἐλπίδας ὥρμησε πρὸς ταύτας τὰς ἐπιβολάς) lacks its subject in the batch; English reading not contradicted.

findings.quote: withdrew, as ordered, to his quarters
findings.problem: Greek reads ἀναχωρήσαντος εἰς ἱμάτιον... with a lacuna/corruption marker; εἰς ἱμάτιον ('into a cloak') is not 'quarters'. The English smooths a corrupt, gapped passage into a whole sentence.
findings.proposed_fix: withdrew, as ordered, [text corrupt or lost here: Greek has εἰς ἱμάτιον ...]

units.note: Also: πικρῶς in 'τοῦ δ᾽ ἀπειπομένου πικρῶς ἐρευνᾶν ᾔτει' is syntactically ambiguous (could go with the denial or with Alexis' demand to search); English 'indignantly denied' is one defensible reading, so no fix proposed.

findings.quote: intending to launch his attack from higher ground on the right
findings.problem: Greek ἐξ ὑπερδεξίου means from a commanding or advantageous (higher) position; it does not say 'on the right'. 'On the right' is added.
findings.proposed_fix: intending to launch his attack from higher ground

units.note: Chapter ends mid-sentence in the Greek (κατεπράϋνε τὴν); the English marks it with [...].

findings.quote: while farther north some parts of it look toward the Pontus in the region above the Phasis, and it stretches to the Hyrcanian Sea
findings.problem: Greek: ὑπέρκειται δ᾽ αὐτῆς τινὰ μέρη τοῦ Πόντου κατὰ τοὺς ὑπὲρ τὸν Φᾶσιν τόπους; the subject is 'some parts of the Pontus', which lie above (beyond) Artabazanes' country. The English makes parts of his country look toward the Pontus.
findings.proposed_fix: while above it lie some parts of the Pontus, in the region beyond the Phasis, and it adjoins the Hyrcanian Sea
